anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps all three facts: it dispatches nothing, places the exact `budget: 2 of 2 spent (not recovered on resume)` line between Problem: and the file finding, and names a newly written `**Amend-grant:** fund 2 fix rounds` line as the refund. Two things drift and could break the refund fact under a stricter reader: option a adds "or reply here with a new funding grant", which introduces an in-chat grant channel that is neither the written header token nor any existing carrier (and comes close to inventing new resume grammar), and the Problem sentence "the restored funding cannot pay ... because no funded-round spending was recovered" muddles cause and effect (missing history is the reason the ledger is treated as exhausted, not a reason the grant cannot pay). After also drops Before's visible reasoning that the header is a fixed observation and that the token was not refunded on the parent's own initiative. Suggested wording: keep option a as a single path - "refund funding by newly writing the plan header line `**Amend-grant:** fund <N> fix rounds` and reply resume" - and phrase Problem as "no funded round lines were recovered on resume, so the ledger is treated as exhausted"; that preserves every fact Before kept while still folding funding into the transition-table stop.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps the exhausted treatment (no dispatch, no reset on resume) and the exact `budget: 2 of 2 spent (not recovered on resume)` line positioned between Problem: and the file finding, but it loses the refund fact: option a now says to refund 'under the existing `**Amend-grant:** fund 2 fix rounds` grant' and the closing note only says 'explicitly authorize the refund in your reply', so the reader is never told that the refund is a newly written budget token — it reads as a reauthorization of the restored header, which the same output says does not reset funding. Before named the mechanism precisely ('issue a newly written `fund 2 fix rounds` grant through the existing grant surface'). To keep all three facts while still delivering the Change's folded funding/recovery table, phrase option a as writing a fresh `fund 2 fix rounds` grant line (not restoring or citing the existing one), and keep the 'no new handoff or resume fields' sentence as the grammar assurance.
